thread:
Maya R: FYI I rolled TenguLite-v1 int8 to staging (build 20260902.5). Quick locale smoke shows a few consistent, small regressions: Japanese era notation (e.g. 'R2 年' -> 'R2年' merged), Korean jamo anchoring issues, and ASCII colon/paren rearranged in Arabic RTL lines. Repro below.
Diego M: Oof. Can you paste the raw input + FP16 vs INT8 outputs?
Maya R: Pasted from staging call (run: stg-tengulite-int8-3219876543).
Input:
```
令和 R2 年 04 月 05 日 提出 (due: 04/05/R2)
제출 마감: 2026 년 07 월 09 일 (due: 07/09/2026)
الموعد: (09/07/2026)
```
FP16 baseline:
```
令和 R2 年 04 月 05 日 提出 (due: 04/05/R2)
제출 마감: 2026 년 07 월 09 일 (due: 07/09/2026)
الموعد: (09/07/2026)
```
INT8 (tengulite-v1 qkernel v1.4.0 fused-kvfold3):
```
令和 R2年04月05日 提出 )due: 04/05/R2(
제출 마감: 2026년07월09일 )due: 07/09/2026(
الموعد: )09/07/2026(
```
Maya R: Notes: Japanese 'R2 年' collapsed to 'R2年' (space removed), Korean shows '2026 년' collapsed as well, Arabic line shows parentheses flipped direction. With `return_tokens=true` the int8 path emits merged tokens for digit+unit (e.g., ['R2\u5e74'] token) while fp16 emits separate tokens ['R2',' ','\u5e74'].
Rina K: Did we change tokenizer/vocab?
Maya R: No — tokenizer package pinned at 1.14 across both runs. Ran token diff: `python ci/token_diff.py --left fp16 --right int8 --sample 777` -> recurring merges around digits + unit CJK/KOR.
Kevin L: Kernel/quant notes: qkernel v1.4.0 enabled fused-kvfold3 and switched to symmetric per-channel int8 with nearest-even rounding to chase perf. Those changes can nudge logits at tight boundaries. We also flipped kvcache-compact on this build.
Diego M: Is this deterministic under greedy/seeded runs? Need to rule out sampling.
Maya R: Deterministic under greedy and seeded sampling (seed=123). Repro is stable.
Rina K: Quick mitigation options?
Kevin L: Two quick attempts: 1) roll back fused-kvfold3 + kvcache-compact in a patch build (cheap) 2) try per-tensor asymmetric quant with zero-point correction. I'll queue patch job.
infra-bot: deploy:staging-tengulite-int8-patch (build: 20260902.5.patch1) started  6 instances.
OpsBot: Suggested checks: run locale smoke across ja,ko,zh,ar with metrics: token_delta_count, chrF, BLEU, bidi_punct_err. Block if zh/ja chrF drop >0.35 or ar BLEU drop >1.0 or token_parity_fail_rate >0.3%.
Diego M: Also run a token-heatmap to find highest-frequency merged tokens — we might be able to blacklist a small set temporarily.
Maya R: Kicked off quick sweep: `./tools/locale_quick --run stg-tengulite-int8-3219876543 --langs ja,ko,zh,ar --out s3://redwood-smoke/tengulite-int8-3219876543.json`  ETA ~18m. Will attach results.
Rina K: If revert fixes things, add deterministic logits-threshold unit tests for patterns: ["R2 \u5e74","2026 \u5e74","(09/07/2026)","2026 년"], and gate fused optimizations behind a stability flag.
Kevin L: Agreed. If patch shows correctness but perf regresses, we can add runtime opt-in and a CI numeric-stability check. Spawning job 50211 for perf comparison.
Maya R: Thanks. If anyone finds other bidi/quote/halfwidth anomalies (e.g., colon vs fullwidth colon), drop examples here. I'll post the smoke artifact and token-delta dump when available. :mag:
